BiblicalUsage: Anem is a town of Issachar, given to the Levites of the family of Gershom, and it appears only once in the whole Bible. The chronicler lists it among the towns where the Levites lived, and says nothing more.
TheologicalSignificance: A town named once and never again still has its place in the record, and I take comfort in that: God keeps the small places too, and no corner of His people's story is forgotten.
